subject: math
title: 10 More and 10 Less Than a Number
seo_title: Grade 1 10 More and 10 Less Worksheets: Base-Ten Blocks and Hundred Chart
domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standard_text: Given a two-digit number, mentally find 10 more or 10 less than the number, without having to count; explain the reasoning used.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets on 10 more and 10 less: add or take away a ten with base-ten blocks, use a hundred chart, compare with 1 more and 1 less, number patterns and short word problems. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: 10 more or 10 less changes only the tens digit.
key_sub: 10 more than 46 is 56. 10 less than 46 is 36. The ones digit stays 6. On a hundred chart, go down 1 row for 10 more and up 1 row for 10 less.
body_html:
10 more and 10 less: change the tens

A number like 34 has 3 tens and 4 ones. To find 10 more, add 1 ten. To find 10 less, take away 1 ten. Only the tens digit changes. The ones digit stays the same. You do not need to count by 1s.

10 more

What is 10 more than 27?

27 is 2 tens and 7 ones. Add 1 ten: 3 tens and 7 ones.

Answer: 37

10 less

What is 10 less than 81?

81 is 8 tens and 1 one. Take away 1 ten: 7 tens and 1 one.

Answer: 71

Use a hundred chart

Each row of a hundred chart has 10 numbers. So the number just below is 10 more. The number just above is 10 less. The number to the right is 1 more, and to the left is 1 less.

Start1 less1 more10 less10 more

Count by 10s from any number

Keep adding 10 and you get a pattern: 14, 24, 34, 44. The ones digit is always 4.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
10 more than 46 is 47 (the ones digit changed)Change the tens digit: 56
10 less than 56 is 55Take away 1 ten: 46
10 more than 35 is 44 (counting on from 35)Start counting after 35, or just add 1 ten: 45
10 more than 46 is 65 (digits turned around)Tens first: 5 tens, 6 ones is 56
Going up a row on a hundred chart for 10 moreDown 1 row is 10 more. Up 1 row is 10 less.

faq.q: How do you find 10 more or 10 less in 1st grade?
faq.a: Change only the tens digit. For 10 more, add 1 ten (34 becomes 44). For 10 less, take away 1 ten (34 becomes 24). The ones digit stays the same.

faq.q: Why does the ones digit stay the same when you add 10?
faq.a: Adding 10 adds one whole ten and no ones. So the number of ones does not change, and only the tens digit goes up by 1.

faq.q: How do you use a hundred chart to find 10 more and 10 less?
faq.a: Find the number on the chart. The number just below it is 10 more, and the number just above it is 10 less, because each row has 10 numbers.

faq.q: Why does my child say 10 more than 46 is 47?
faq.a: They are changing the ones digit, as if adding 1. Build 46 with 4 ten rods and 6 cubes, add one more rod, and count the tens: 5 tens and 6 ones is 56.

items.q: Ava had some cards. She got 10 more cards. Now she has 52 cards. How many cards did she have before?
